name: IBY_TEMP_PMT_INSTR_USES
description: IBY_TEMP_PMT_INSTR_USES links external payees and payers to their external payment instruments.

columns.name: FEEDER_IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Feeder system identifier for controlling the import process

columns.name: TEMP_EXT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Assigns bank account to new payee/payer. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations.

columns.name: EXT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Assigns existing bank account to existing payee. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations.

columns.name: INSTRUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Instrument type. Use: BANKACCOUNT. Values are maintained by the lookup type IBY_INSTRUMENT_TYPES.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLOW
columns.description: Specifies funds capture or disbursement flow. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations. Use the Manage Lookup Types task, lookup type IBY_PAYMENT_FLOW to identify valid values.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates bank account is primary for defaulting on invoices. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the instrument use. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Relationship start date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be earlier than END_DATE.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Relationship end date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be later than START_DATE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated. Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
